jvm.description: Contains Java Virtual Machine (JVM) statistics for the node.

mem.description: Contains statistics about memory usage for the node.

name.description: Human-readable identifier for the node. Based on the Node name setting setting.

transport_address.description: The host and port where transport HTTP connections are accepted.

heap_max.description: Maximum amount of memory available for use by the heap.

heap_max_in_bytes.description: Maximum amount of memory, in bytes, available for use by the heap.

java_inference.description: Amount of Java heap currently being used for caching inference models.

java_inference_in_bytes.description: Amount of Java heap, in bytes, currently being used for caching inference models.

java_inference_max.description: Maximum amount of Java heap to be used for caching inference models.

java_inference_max_in_bytes.description: Maximum amount of Java heap, in bytes, to be used for caching inference models.

adjusted_total.description:
If the amount of physical memory has been overridden using the es.total_memory_bytes system property
then this reports the overridden value. Otherwise it reports the same value as total.

adjusted_total_in_bytes.description:
If the amount of physical memory has been overridden using the `es.total_memory_bytes` system property
then this reports the overridden value in bytes. Otherwise it reports the same value as `total_in_bytes`.

total_in_bytes.description: Total amount of physical memory in bytes.

ml.description: Contains statistics about machine learning use of native memory on the node.

anomaly_detectors.description: Amount of native memory set aside for anomaly detection jobs.

anomaly_detectors_in_bytes.description: Amount of native memory, in bytes, set aside for anomaly detection jobs.

data_frame_analytics.description: Amount of native memory set aside for data frame analytics jobs.

data_frame_analytics_in_bytes.description: Amount of native memory, in bytes, set aside for data frame analytics jobs.

max.description: Maximum amount of native memory (separate to the JVM heap) that may be used by machine learning native processes.

max_in_bytes.description: Maximum amount of native memory (separate to the JVM heap), in bytes, that may be used by machine learning native processes.

native_code_overhead.description: Amount of native memory set aside for loading machine learning native code shared libraries.

native_code_overhead_in_bytes.description: Amount of native memory, in bytes, set aside for loading machine learning native code shared libraries.

native_inference.description: Amount of native memory set aside for trained models that have a PyTorch model_type.

native_inference_in_bytes.description: Amount of native memory, in bytes, set aside for trained models that have a PyTorch model_type.
